summary.text: Gena Ozols is the Democratic candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Rebecca Winegar.
A community organizer, she advanced from the Democratic primary on June 30, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Gena Ozols was born in Fairfield, California, and earned a high school diploma from Smoky Hill High School.
Her career experience includes working as a community organizer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Ozols described herself as a lifelong Coloradan who has worked on reproductive rights, racial justice, labor rights and equity issues.

She said she has served as a field director, board and commission member and policy director while running a small business that supports nonprofits with strategic planning, coalition building and campaign expertise.
Her stated key message is that government should work for everyone, including access to quality health care, affordable housing and safe transportation.
